description: A corporate power of attorney: a principal (here a mortgage lender) appoints an agent to act in its name, with the execution, signature blocks and notarial acknowledgment

principal.description: The party granting the power, named as 'the Principal'

name.description: The principal's name, from the blank before '(the "Principal")'

office_address.description: The address of the principal's principal offices, as printed

county.description: The county of the principal's offices, from the blank before 'County'

state.description: The state of the principal's offices, from the blank after 'State of' in the opening paragraph

representative_name.description: The authorized individual representing the principal, from the blank before '(name)'

representative_title.description: That individual's title, from the blank before '(title)'

agent.description: The party appointed as attorney-in-fact, named as 'the Agent'

name.description: The agent's full name, from the text after 'appoint, and constitute' and before 'of'

address.description: The agent's address, from the text after the agent's name and 'of'

powers_granted.description: Each numbered power the agent is given, in order, summarized in a short phrase

items.description: One granted power, e.g. 'execute, endorse, assign and deliver promissory notes'

is_irrevocable.description: True if the principal renounces the right to revoke the power of attorney

survives_incapacity.description: True if acts by the agent remain binding after the principal's bankruptcy, dissolution, incapacity or death (a durable power)

execution_date.description: The date the document was executed, from 'Executed this __ day of __, 20__', as YYYY-MM-DD

principal_signature.description: The principal's signature block, the left-hand column under the execution line

signer_name.description: The printed name after 'Name:' in the principal's (left) signature block

signer_title.description: The title after 'Title:' in the principal's (left) signature block

is_signed.description: True if a signature appears on the 'By:' line of the principal's (left) block

agent_signature.description: The agent's signature block, the right-hand column headed by the agent's company name

company.description: The company named at the head of the agent's (right) signature block

signer_name.description: The printed name after 'Name:' in the agent's (right) block, or null if blank

is_signed.description: True if a signature appears on the 'By:' line of the agent's (right) block

notary.description: The notarial acknowledgment at the foot of the document

state.description: The state of the acknowledgment, from 'State of' in the notary section

county.description: The county of the acknowledgment, from 'County of' in the notary section

acknowledgment_date.description: The date the signer appeared before the notary, from 'I certify that on __, __, __', as YYYY-MM-DD

commission_expiration.description: The date the notary's commission expires, as YYYY-MM-DD

is_notarized.description: True if the notary has signed the acknowledgment
